hook: Me re-teeing the ball for the ninth time while everyone waits.
beats: Mulligan: This one's going three hundred.
Birdie: The ball won't even stay up.
setting: On a tee box with tee markers and the fairway stretching out behind them.
action: Mulligan jabs a tee into the ground and the ball keeps rolling off; on his third try he announces his line, then the ball tips off again and he just stares.

dialogue.speaker: Birdie
dialogue.line: The ball won't even stay up.

sound: birdsong, a tee tapping, a ball plopping off, a tiny sigh
judge: Ball won't stay up is relatable but 'Warm-up' is a soft button.
